Forwarding Aidan's note — they're asking about publicity opt-in and logo rules for a pilot (Meadow Pilot). Please prioritize a quick review of the publicity and confidentiality language. High-level asks from me:
- No automatic opt-in; we should require explicit marketing consent (separate form) for any public announcement.
- Tighten the 'references' clause so pilot customer testimonials are permitted only as anonymized metrics unless they sign off on a quote.
- Add an embargo window option (they proposed immediate visibility; propose 45 days post-go-live for coordinated press).

Karthik — can you produce a redline focusing on Sections 4–6 and include a short rationale per clause?
Marissa — marketing input: can you draft a one-page consent template that offers options: quote + logo, logo-only, anonymous metrics? We want something Meadow can sign quickly.

Thanks — want to return something to them by EOD tomorrow.

Laura / team,

I've attached a focused redline (redline_meadow_msa_20250930.docx) and summarized the proposed edits below so we can move fast:

1) Publicity / Opt-in (Section 5): replace any 'opt-out' or passive language with explicit opt-in. Add a short marketing consent addendum reference (we'll attach template).
2) References / Testimonials (Section 6): require written consent for any customer-identifying quotes; permit anonymized aggregated metrics (e.g., "Meadow saw a 20% reduction in X during the pilot") without attribution.
3) Logo use: require separate logo permission with a usage guide attached. Prohibit modifications to Redwood's mark and require color/clear-space rules.
4) Embargo: offer an optional 45-day embargo from pilot start for coordinated announcements; include a mechanism to request earlier publicity by mutual written agreement.
5) Evidence & audit: ask Meadow to produce a minimal evidence packet (date-stamped pilot start, scope, sample logs) if they want to call out specific performance numbers in public material — this prevents exaggerated claims.

I'll flag two clauses for potential negotiation: a) their standard broad "reference" language that automatically licenses all publicity; and b) any blanket indemnity tied to marketing claims.

Attachment: redline_meadow_msa_20250930.docx

-Karthik
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

Quick notes from Marketing:

- Consent options should be clear and actionable. I'd prefer a single-page consent that Meadow can sign post-execution that lists:
  * \"OK to use logo in co-branded collateral\" (with usage rules)
  * \"OK to be quoted\" (with ability to pre-approve quote)
  * \"OK to publish anonymized metrics\"

- Embargo: 45 days is fine, but for our roadmap we sometimes need shorter windows for pilot-to-paid conversions. Suggest including a checkbox in the consent for the customer to allow earlier publication for go-to-market reasons (mutual written agreement).

- Also recommend we provide a single set of approved logo assets and a short 'how to use' JPG/PNG pack so the customer doesn't accidentally misuse the mark. I'll attach the first-draft consent template.

Attachment: marketing_consent_template_v1.pdf

Thanks for sending the draft. Attached are two items from our side: a redlined MSA focused on Sections 4–6 (redline_meadow_msa_20250930.docx) and a one-page marketing consent template (marketing_consent_template_v1.pdf). Summary of where we landed:

- Publicity is explicit opt-in only: no automatic inclusion in press or case studies.
- Logo use requires separate written permission using the consent template; we've attached approved assets and usage rules in the Drive link.
